course.title: Humanities 11th
course.description:
"PRARAMBH 2.O Class 11th - Humanities" - A Yearlong Live Interactive Course designed to help you excel in the 2026 11th class exams.

 

1. We'll cover Geography, Political Science, History, Economics,Maths , Hindi & English for class 11th students.

2. Live lectures will be conducted, and in case you miss a session, recordings will be available to students in the Next Toppers app.

3. Classes will be scheduled to align with your school timings.

4. There will be two classes per day, each lasting 1 to 1.5 hours.

5. A weekly schedule will be provided for your convenience.

6. Class notes will be provided in PDF format after each class on the Next Toppers App.

7. Regular tests will be conducted to assess your progress.

8. The entire course will remain accessible to you until your final exams in 2026.

9. English will be covered in recorded format, so that you can cover it as per your convinience.

10. This batch is non-refundable and non-transferable.
For Further Enquiry Please Contact us on our following communication Platforms
Email-Support@nexttoppers.com
Inquiry-  9109771477
WebSite - http://https://nexttoppers.com/
